GET IN TOUCH
FAMILY OWNED & OPERATED

Welcome to Sasquatch Family Farms. Hope grows here along with some incredibly fun pasture-raised animals living their best lives. We believe in regenerative farming practices and giving back to the land that feeds our community. The farm is a place to come as you are and have a great time connecting. When we started the farm we wanted it to be a place for the community to continue to gather and make memories. If you have never been here before, we want you to leave as a friend who knows they have a connection to a farm, our family, and a community.

ABOUT US
OUR MISSION

At Sasquatch Family Farms, family is at the heart of everything we do. We’re grateful for the chance to work alongside our kids and build something meaningful together. Our mission is to unite family, friends, and the community through the shared experience of great food. In a world that often pulls us in different directions, we hope to create spaces where people can come together, reconnect, and celebrate the simple joys of good company and quality meals. Hope, community, and connection thrive here at Sasquatch Family Farms.

OUR PRACTICES

At Sasquatch Family Farms, we’re passionate about raising top-quality food from our farm to your families table, pasture-raised pork and lamb. Our commitment to superior meat led us to bring in registered Berkshire hogs, rigorously tested for their genetics and meat quality, called the "wagyu" of pork by foodies. When you taste the meat you understand our passion about genetics and pork. These hogs live out their lives right here on the farm, enjoying wide-open spaces to run, root, and thrive as true country pigs.

Our farm is Animal Welfare Certified we take caring for our animals seriously. They are fed nutritionist approved hog food supplemented with lots and lots of fruits and veggies. Berkshire hogs are renowned for their marbled, dark, and exceptionally tender meat, Berkshire pork offers a flavor and texture you won’t find at the grocery store — and that’s what drew us in from the start. We’re proud of the consistency and quality they bring to the table. To make it easier for you, we offer USDA cuts by the pound, as well as customizable bundles and subscription plans.

ABOUT US
OUR STORY

FUN on the farm. We are inspired to live our best lives and for everyone to have FUN while they are here. The farm is part of the historical Herren Homestead. Farming has been a part of the history of the land for the last 140 years. It has traditionally hosted events like the Toledo Thrushing Bee. If you spend an afternoon in our pasture you will laugh at the antics of the pigs and lambs while watching skydivers from Toledo Skydive, RC airplanes from the Lewis County RC Club, and aircraft taking off and landing at the Toledo Airport. The farm has territorial mountain views of both Mt. Rainier and Mt. St. Helens.

Our farm experiences are joyful ways to connect with your farmers, learn how your food is grown, and help our kids know what it sounds, smells, and looks like to produce food in the Pacific Northwest.

We are looking forward to hosting many community events starting in 2024 with our Easter Egg Hunt, farm-to-table dinners, a Starry Night, and so much more. Our daily farming operation is producing local hay and raising pasture-fed pigs and lambs for our community that are USDA-processed from the farm to your local table.

OUR PRODUCTS
CLEAN EATING FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY

We are a small family owned and operated, independent, first-generation farm in Lewis County, built with care, hard work, and a deep respect for the land and the animals we raise. From the very beginning in 2023, our values have been simple and non-negotiable: no antibiotics, no growth hormones, no weird additives, and no herbicides or pesticides on our fields—ever. YES we 100% eat what we grow. It’s delicious.

We believe good food starts with good stewardship. That’s why we partner with local sources to rescue fresh produce that would otherwise be rejected and sent to the landfill. Our animals enjoy this abundance as part of their free-choice diets—bananas, papaya, watermelon, cantaloupe, pineapple, apples, and more. They eat exceptionally well, live curious and enriched lives, and yes… they’re true foodies.

Raising animals this way takes more time, more attention, and more heart—but the result is food you can feel confident serving to your family. Meat that reflects care at every step, from soil to pasture to plate.

We sell directly to you, our community. Our meat is slaughtered and butchered under USDA inspection at a small, independent processor that is Animal Welfare Approved, because how an animal is treated at the end matters just as much as how it is raised.

Thank you for choosing food with integrity.

VISIT ONLINE STORE
ETHICALLY-RAISED PORK

Ethical, Humane, hormone-free. YOU care so do we!

Our pigs are all-natural, and we offer full customization of sausage, bacon, and cured products. Because we primarily harvest under USDA inspection, you can purchase as little as 1 lb of bacon or as much as will fit in your freezer—perfect for sharing with friends and family. We work directly with the meat shop to ensure your order is cut and processed exactly to your preferences.

Orders fill quickly and often sell out months in advance—reserve yours as soon as possible.

SHOP ONLINE
HIGH-QUALITY BEEF

Did you know it takes 5 years for the beef grow cycle? While we wait for the “Butter Sister” to have our first calves born at Sasquatch Family Farms in the fall of 2026. You have said you want beef that is local from a farmer you can trust. So while we wait for our fajitas to grow out we currently source local feeder cows and beef from small family farms that we know and trust that have our same values. Our all-natural beef is grass-fed and grass-finished, and dry-aged for 14 days for the best flavor. Stock up on healthy, high-quality meat. Get a variety of cuts (and even some new ones to try). Customize your order to get your meat exactly the way you want.

SHOP ONLINE
PASTURED LAMB

When you pre-order lamb from us, you’re doing more than purchasing exceptional meat—you’re supporting kids. We proudly give back 100% of lamb sale profits directly to FFA, helping students fund their projects and see real returns for their hard work.

We work hard to keep the cost of purchasing a lamb for FFA affordable, while ensuring that on the sales end, students are able to make a meaningful profit. It’s a model built on fairness, opportunity, and belief in young farmers.

Help us help them. Your purchase makes a difference.

LEARN MORE
SHOP ONLINE
FARM-FRESH EGGS

Our poultry program is still growing, but it’s rooted in the same values as everything we do: animal welfare, nutrient-dense food, and community care. This project allows us to both give back and, soon, offer eggs and poultry directly through our website.

So far, our family is incredibly happy with the results—and we hope you’ll love this new farm food as much as we do.

Stay tuned. Sign up for our newsletter to be the first to know when eggs, chicken, and turkey are available. So far this has been one of those things we are selling out of before we can even post it.
